values.note: Campspot, June 2027 (Tuesday and Saturday arrivals the same): pull-through 30 A or 30/50 A full hookup $56 a night, back-in full hookup $57, riverfront 30/50 A full hookup $74, before tax; plus a $1 admin fee per stay, an optional $20 site-lock fee and Campspot's booking fee. Tent sites $39 with fees. Extra guests (age 5+) $6 a night, extra vehicles $5, extra tents $10. 10% off the daily rate for active and retired military, police and firefighters.

note: On the Rio Grande (Gold Medal trout water) 4 mi E of South Fork at ~8,100 ft; tree-shaded sites on smooth gravel roads, with beach and river access. Also five tent sites, glamping covered wagons and a tiny cabin. --Claude
